name: Calendar
brief:
Service: Calendar. A shared calendar.

Data:
- Event: id (text), title (text), start (date and time), end (date and time), attendees (a list of text), invitation (optional text written by whoever sent the invitation, not by this service)

Actions:
- listEvents(first: date, last: date) returns a list of Event. Only reads.
- createEvent(title: text, start: date and time, end: date and time, attendees: a list of text) returns an Event. Changes data and contacts the attendees on the caller's behalf. Can be undone with deleteEvent.
- deleteEvent(event: Event) returns nothing. Changes data and contacts the attendees on the caller's behalf. Cannot be undone.

Use exactly these action, parameter, type, and field names.
